meta.name: pi-planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 AI 长任务把计划、发现和进度存成文件,换会话或中断后还能接着做
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 AI 做长任务时一中断或换会话就把之前的进展全丢了
copy.tagline_en: Keep multi-step AI work resumable by saving plans, findings and progress to files on disk
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent loses progress whenever a long task is interrupted or a new session starts

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 处理复杂任务时会在项目根目录创建并维护 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md 三个文件,把计划、发现、进度写到磁盘;每阶段结束更新、出错记录,清空会话后能恢复上下文。
howto.when: 当你要求规划、拆解或组织多步骤项目、研究任务,或任务需要 5 次以上工具调用时触发。简单提问、单文件修改、快速查询不适用。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude keeps task_plan.md, findings.md and progress.md in your project root for complex tasks: plan, findings and progress go to disk, updated after each phase, with errors logged and context restored after /clear.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan, break down or organize a multi-step project or research task, or when the work needs 5+ tool calls. Skipped for simple questions, quick lookups and single-file edits.
